tony_sales: Heads-up  Prospect ClearLedger returned our security questionnaire with a hard ask: dual HSM clusters (us-east/us-west), weekly rotation at 22:00 PST, zero exposure of unwrapped keys anywhere, and they marked "vendor-managed Shamir" as preferred. Can we do this for the POC?
rachel_se: Quick clarification: we support BYO keys via an HSM proxy and will accept wrapped key blobs. We do NOT implement vendor-side Shamir secret sharing. Customers must split keys client-side or via a partner inside their network. We can accept the wrapped shares and perform signing against provided handles.
rachel_se: Minimal POC proxy example:
```
proxy_mode: accept-wrapped
hsm_endpoints:
  - hsm-east.local:1234
  - hsm-west.local:1234
validate_wrap: true
rotation_window: weekly@22:00-PST
```
priya_security: Security notes: 1) If "vendor Shamir" is non-negotiable, we need to log that as a non-offered feature and propose a partner-managed integration in the SOW. 2) We need HSM vendor attestations (FIPS module & firmware, module ID) up-front. 3) No plaintext/unwrapped key material in logs  only digests/hashes allowed.
marco_sre: Perf heads-up: cross-region HSM calls add ~8-14ms typical; synchronous dual-endorse will increase p99 significantly. If ClearLedger wants synchronous dual-sign for compliance, call out the latency impact in the RFQ. For the POC we can run a mocked HSM to estimate baseline then run an end-to-end test with real HSMs.
tony_sales: They also want pricing expressed as a "per-sign" audit line item for their finance team. Ops baseline for quote: 3M sign ops/day peak, retention ask = 13 months.
rachel_se: Pricing approach suggestion: reserved proxy nodes (monthly) + tiered per-1M-sign blocks (discount at volume). Add an optional line for "failover/chaos tests" as a one-time billable service. I'll sketch numbers.
priya_security: Audit logs: we can send signed digests to the customer's SIEM and redact any wrapped blobs. Anything >12 months retention requires legal + SOC2 addendum. I'll flag legal.
marco_sre: Onboarding checklist for POC (minimal):
1) Allowlist Redwood egress IPs (e.g., 198.51.100.40/32)
2) Upload HSM cert chains & module IDs to Console
3) Provide sample wrapped key shares (client-split)
4) Run handshake + sign test vectors at incremental QPS (100k, 500k, 1M)
5) Execute rotation dry-run at 22:00 PST
Estimate: 2 SREs x 5 days + 1 security engineer x 3 days for attestation/pack.
ci-bot: CI: byo-hsm-proxy-stub v2.4 build queued -> https://ci.redwood/build/9876 :rocket:
tony_sales: Customer pushed back hard on "client-side Shamir". They prefer vendor-managed because of internal policy. Any workaround?
rachel_se: Workaround: we can document an approved partner integration where partner runs the splitting service in the customer's network (partner does the Shamir split, returns wrapped shares). We accept the wrapped artifacts. Add partner integration as a separate line in SOW and call out customer responsibility for keying ceremony.
priya_security: I'll prepare the vendor-cert checklist to include with the SOW: FIPS certs, module ID, firmware version, attestation letter, and any HSM vendor CVEs. Also include a short list of vetted Shamir client libraries we recommend.
tony_sales: OK. Action items: Rachel draft 2-week POC SOW (acceptance: dual-sign failover, rotation dry-run at 22:00 PST, no plaintext logs, audit retention & SIEM shipping). Include pricing appendix with reserved + per-sign tiers and optional chaos test and partner-split integration fee. Priya, assemble cert checklist and retention/legal note. Marco, confirm engineer-hour estimate. I'll send updated RFQ after drafts. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
